repo.label: Repository
repo.description: GitHub repository to watch, as owner/name (for example octocat/hello-world).

branch.label: Branch
branch.description: Only show runs for this branch, for example main. Leave empty for the latest run on any branch.

token.label: GitHub token
token.description: Optional. Needed for private repositories and faster polling. Use a fine-grained token limited to this repository with Actions: Read-only.
